questions.question: Where do you have to open the golden egg to hear its clue?
questions.note: The clue is the merpeople's song, and it is only clear underwater.

questions.question: What tournament does Hogwarts host in Harry's fourth year?
questions.note: Three schools, three tasks, one champion each. The Goblet picks a fourth name anyway.

questions.question: Which school arrives in a flying carriage pulled by winged horses?
questions.note: Fleur Delacour is their champion. Madame Maxime is the headmistress.

questions.question: Which school arrives in a ship that rises out of the lake?
questions.note: Viktor Krum is their champion. Igor Karkaroff is the headmaster.

questions.question: Who is the Hogwarts student the Goblet picks before it also spits out Harry's name?
questions.note: He is a Hufflepuff. Entering your name is a binding magical contract, so Harry has to compete.

questions.question: What dragon does Harry face in the first task?
questions.note: He has to get a golden egg away from a nesting dragon. He summons his broom and flies for it.

questions.question: In the film, who gives Harry the gillyweed for the lake task?
questions.note: Fake Moody steers Neville to a book on water plants, and Neville brings the gillyweed. In the book, Dobby is the one who hands it over.

questions.question: Who is Harry supposed to rescue from the Black Lake?
questions.note: Each champion saves the person they would miss most. Harry also brings Fleur's sister Gabrielle up, and the judges put him second for it.

questions.question: What is the Triwizard Cup secretly turned into?
questions.note: The maze is the third task. Touching the Cup takes Harry and Cedric out of Hogwarts.

questions.question: Who is Hermione's date to the Yule Ball?
questions.note: Ron is furious. Harry goes with Parvati Patil after Cho says Cedric already asked her.
